# Seriti Skills Development PBO

> Seriti Skills Development PBO is a South African Public Benefit Organisation based in Milnerton, Cape Town, running a Maintenance Plumbing and Entrepreneurial Skills Development program. The program trains community members in practical plumbing maintenance and small-business skills, pairing instruction with mentorship and apprenticeship placements so graduates can find employment or start their own plumbing maintenance business.

## Program

- Maintenance Plumbing and Entrepreneurial Skills Development: hands-on plumbing maintenance training combined with entrepreneurship and small-business skills.
- Structure: Learn the Trade → Apprentice & Mentor → Business Skills → Work & Earn.
- Goals: restore dignity through practical skill, build employability in the plumbing maintenance trade, and build participant understanding of water and land conservation.

## Support & Donations

- Seriti Skills Development PBO is a registered Public Benefit Organisation and issues Section 18A tax certificates for donations, making it eligible for corporate CSR/ESG giving.
- Contact for partnership or donation enquiries: info@seritipbo.org

## Organisation details
